ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the RS-1,
Residential Single-Unit (Detached House); RS-3, Residential Single-Unit (Detached
House) and B3-1, Community Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on
Map No. 24-G in the area bound by:

West 95" Street; the alley next west of and parallel to South Vincennes Avenue; the
alley next south of and parallel to West 95" Street; and a line 193.17 feet east of and
parallel to South Throop Street,

to those of a RT-4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

2— Lee

Ronnie L. Mosley
Alderman, 21%t Ward

Common Address:
1123-1237 W. 95th Street
